item.title: Footpath update - Planning approved, 22nd September
item.description:
A footpath plan was approved, and the council was going to open the path from the park side so we (Stone Crescent neighbourhood) could use it to get to King George Playing Field. I’ve lived on Stone Crescent (new-build home) since February 2026, but there's been no update on the footpath to the playing field/park. Please see the attached map (Pic 1) for reference. The path was approved between 25 Stone Crescent and 23 Stone Crescent, GL51 8DP; please see the current status on the development side in Pic 2. A fence is blocking access to the park. The developers have told us the council will come and open the path from the park side. Please update me on when you plan to open the path and the timescale.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Brooklyn Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Resurfacing works around Chosen Way estate, 22nd September
item.description:
The whole of the estate has been asked to remove vehicles from the roadside since Sunday 20th Sept for 4 days. The works are nowhere near finished for such a large estate with only 1 day remaining. The quality of resurfacing work that has been completed is very poor with uneven tarmac. Gloucestershire Highways need to check why blanket road parking restrictions are being issued way too far in advance and why the quality of work is so poor. It's a massive inconvenience to residents and taking so long that the notices are being ignored anyway.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Chosen Way, Hucclecote, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Unsafe surface on the footpath, 22nd September
item.description:
The stretch of Naunton Lane footpath that runs from the corner by Whitecross Square up to the end of the footpath opposite Naunton Park is very unsafe as it is so uneven. My husband tripped over yesterday due to the surface. We are expecting a baby and it will be difficult and dangerous to take a pram down this footpath due to the surface. It is also very close to Naunton Park primary school and will be unsafe for small children/ the elderly.
